Document Submission Protocol

To protect sensitive medical records, discharge cards, and confidential policy schedules, do NOT upload files on this public intake screen. Once your docket is registered, your assigned Legal Custodian will send you an end-to-end encrypted submission link and official email request for your discharge summary, diagnostic bills, and insurer rejection memo.

menu_book Legal Precedent Note

Section 45 & Unfair Repudiation

Under recent Supreme Court rulings (Manmohan Nanda v. United India) and Insurance Ombudsman guidelines, insurers cannot repudiate non-disclosure claims without establishing a direct causal nexus to the hospitalized condition.
